name: Hungarian sweet paprika
where: Great Market Hall spice stalls or Vásárcsarnok grocery shops
about: Ground red paprika is the country's signature spice and a staple of Hungarian goulash. Szeged and Kalocsa are its best-known growing regions.
tip: Check the origin label for Szeged or Kalocsa, and confirm whether it is sweet or hot before you buy.

name: Tokaji Aszú dessert wine
about: A honeyed dessert wine made from botrytis-affected grapes in the Tokaj region. Hungary has made it for centuries.
tip: Check the grade and vintage on the label, since they set the sweetness and price.

name: Kalocsa embroidery piece
about: Colorful flower embroidery from the Kalocsa region, a traditional folk craft shown on Hungarian clothing and linens.
tip: Ask whether the piece is hand-embroidered, since machine-made versions are common.
